title: Anatomy Control Plane — Evidence Boundary Lab
summary: A fixed, synthetic demonstration of fail-closed intent and evidence outcomes. It is advisory, non-executable, and does not authenticate identities or verify signatures.

payload.provenance: User-supplied attachment; no repository or source revision was established.

related_implementation.label: Related public Anatomy Ledger implementation
related_implementation.relationship: Related implementation observed in the estate snapshot; not proven to be the source of the uploaded payload.

scenarios.label: Read request
scenarios.detail: The Python twin finds the supplied attributes eligible for a read, but authenticates no identity and dispatches nothing.

scenarios.label: Cross-tenant request
scenarios.detail: Mismatched tenant identifiers are denied by the advisory evaluator.

scenarios.label: Unsigned provenance
scenarios.detail: A structurally valid statement without a fresh trusted verifier result cannot become release authority.

scenarios.label: Empty evidence ledger
scenarios.detail: Zero admitted records remain zero; the demonstration does not seed synthetic attestations.

boundaries: No Cedar CLI, OPA engine, Sigstore verifier, or DSSE signature verification ran in the uploaded one-shot.
Caller-supplied approval, MFA, identity, and verification fields are not trusted authority.
The raw attachment and its loopback HTTP server are not published by this showcase.
The related a11oy package remains the canonical public implementation; protected merge and deployment are separate gates.
